title: Fields to display on Board View apply to the cards and persist
custom_preconds:
Signed in as Admin (sees financial data), viewport 1024 px or wider
The admin's saved Work Orders view is reset over the API (display List), so Board View shows its default fields
A throwaway customer with a unique name and no pinned note, with a vehicle carrying a known VIN
One work order with one line for that customer and vehicle; seeding is pinned to the browser's current location

custom_steps_separated.content: Open /workorders, pick Board View from the display switcher, and search for the unique customer name
custom_steps_separated.expected: The work order's card shows the customer name and no VIN
Customer is on and VIN/serial is off

custom_steps_separated.content: Turn Customer off and VIN/serial on
custom_steps_separated.expected: Without a reload, the card no longer shows the customer and shows the vehicle VIN

custom_steps_separated.content: Once the preference is saved, reload the page cold with the same search
custom_steps_separated.expected:
Board View reopens, and the card still shows the VIN and no customer. In Fields to display, Customer is off and VIN/serial is on

Board View field choices apply to the cards immediately and are restored from the account after a reload, and the newly shown field renders the work order's real VIN
